title: arXiv versioned preprint infrastructure: correction-memory rail for physical-science anomalies
summary: arXiv is encoded as correction-memory infrastructure: it provides public, versioned scholarly distribution and preserves previous versions, but does not peer-review content. This helps anomaly trajectories remain inspectable without turning arXiv into a truth engine.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0021 anomaly/correction infrastructure pass.

place.scope: cross-field scholarly preprint/versioning infrastructure, especially strong in physics and adjacent sciences

subjects.name: versioned preprint dissemination and correction memory

claims.claim: arXiv describes itself as a free distribution/open-access archive for scholarly articles and explicitly states that materials are not peer-reviewed by arXiv.
what_would_change_status: arXiv changes its scope or peer-review policy statement.

claims.claim: arXiv documentation says each public version is permanent, replacement or withdrawal creates a new version, and previous versions remain useful for peer review, verification, and priority.
what_would_change_status: arXiv changes version-retention policy or the documentation is superseded.

claims.claim: In this cube, arXiv is a correction-memory rail rather than an arbiter of truth: OPERA final-version replacement and BICEP2 version/publication surfaces are useful precisely because they make claim movement inspectable.
what_would_change_status: A future infrastructure review finds arXiv versioning is less useful for correction-memory work than encoded here.

evidence_refs.support_type: this infrastructure record defines the bounded interpretation

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass official arXiv documentation plus anomaly-lane examples
limitations: No policy-history timeline for arXiv versioning.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: Public article/version identifiers, replacement/withdrawal version history, and subject-category indexing capture movement in claims over time.
outputs: Links to published versions when available
limitations: Versioning preserves movement but does not establish correctness.
Submissions, withdrawals, and replacements require domain interpretation.

handling_notes: Do not treat preprint presence as quality endorsement.
Use versioning as provenance, not verdict.

unknowns: No API or metadata-harvest implementation has been added.
No source-rot or archive strategy for arXiv-linked PDFs exists yet.
